abstract: Namecheap suits a small first site on a low budget. Cybernews measured 99.29% uptime, and renewals are more than double the promo price.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It is good for a small first site on a low budget. Cybernews called it a great domain provider and weak web hosting.

mainEntity.name: How much does Namecheap hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Promo prices start at $2.28 a month for Stellar. Renewal is $55.88 a year for Stellar, $85.44 for Stellar Plus and $128.88 for Stellar Business.
Cybernews measured 99.29% uptime over two weeks. Namecheap itself claims a 100% uptime guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Namecheap money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Namecheap lists 30 days for first-time shared customers. It does not apply together with the 30-day free period.
Yes. It lists AI for WordPress and Sitejet AI Website Builder on every shared plan. We did not test them.

mainEntity.name: Does Namecheap have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Black Friday page we read still referred to 2025. Check the page on the day you buy.
